en: Whatever you have will end,
but what Allah has is lasting.
but what Allah has is lasting.
And We will surely give those who were patient their reward
according to the best of what they used to do.
Whoever does righteousness,
whether male or female,
while he is a believer -
while he is a believer -
We will surely cause him to live a good life,
and We will surely give them
and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter]
according to the best of what they used to do.
So when you recite the Qur'an,
[first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
Indeed, there is for him no authority
over those who have believed
and rely upon their Lord.
His authority is only
over those who take him as an ally
and those who through him associate others with Allah.
